question: Find the value of [(22 times 6)times left{4div 4times ((19-12))/(7)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

[(22 × 6)× {4 ÷ 4 × ((19-12))/(7)}]

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

Expression: [(22 × 6)× {4 ÷ 4 × ((19 - 12))/(7)}]

⇒ [(22 × 6)× {4 ÷ 4 × (7)/(7)}]

⇒ [(22 × 6)× {4 ÷ 4 × 1}]

⇒ [(22 × 6)× {1 × 1}]

⇒ (22 × 6) × 1

⇒ 132

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
